comment: Turret layout of the ZVex Fuzz Factory, one board, values printed on every part; two AC128 and one 2N3904, five pots. A stray '10uF' label sits on the Drive pot body beside lug 2, whose wire runs to the radial 10uF on the board.
uncertain: 10uF: three electrolytics are drawn on the board (two axial, one radial); the extra '10uF' text on the Drive pot is read as a label for the radial one, not a fourth capacitor
